commands.command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery
manifest=$base/spool/jobs.tsv
archive=$base/printed
awk 'NR==1 { if ($1 != "job_id" || $2 != "payload" || NF != 2) exit 10; next } NF != 2 { exit 11 } { if (seen[$1]++) exit 12; print $1, $2 } END { if (NR < 2) exit 13 }' "$manifest" > /tmp/archive-recovery-jobs
while read job_id payload; do
    case "$job_id" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*) printf 'invalid job_id: %s\n' "$job_id" >&2; exit 20;; esac
    case "$payload" in ''|*/*) printf 'invalid payload name: %s\n' "$payload" >&2; exit 21;; esac
    source_file=$base/spool/$payload
    destination=$archive/$job_id.prn
    [ -f "$source_file" ] || { printf 'missing payload: %s\n' "$source_file" >&2; exit 22; }
    temporary=$(mktemp "$archive/.recover-$job_id.XXXXXX")
    cp --preserve=mode,timestamps -- "$source_file" "$temporary"
    chown lp:lp "$temporary"
    chmod 0640 "$temporary"
    sync -f "$temporary"
    if ln "$temporary" "$destination" 2>/dev/null; then
        rm -f "$temporary"
        sync -f "$archive"
        printf 'recovered %s -> %s\n' "$job_id" "$destination"
    elif cmp -s "$temporary" "$destination"; then
        rm -f "$temporary"
        printf 'already recovered identically: %s\n' "$job_id"
    else
        rm -f "$temporary"
        printf 'conflicting recovered payload: %s\n' "$job_id" >&2
        exit 23
    fi
done < /tmp/archive-recovery-jobs
rm -f /tmp/archive-recovery-jobs
restorecon -RF /srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/printed
printf '%s\n' '--- recovered payloads ---'
find "$archive" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %s bytes\n' | sort
sha256sum "$base"/spool/*.prn "$archive"/*.prn | sort -k2
